content.introduction: On November 2, 2026, the main stock market index of the United States, the US Index 500, had varying reported values: one source stated it rose to 7609 points, gaining 0.38% from the previous session; another reported it fell to 7574 points, losing 0.08% from the previous session; and a third source indicated it rose to 7618 points, gaining 0.50% from the previous session. All sources agreed that over the past month, the index had declined between 2.01% and 2.57%, though it remained between 10.54% and 11.18% higher than a year ago. The United States Stock Market Index reached an all-time high of 7844.67 in October of 2026.
